policy: External file verified against every delivered source WAV. Panel speech plays from input sample zero using the two archived af_heart echo gains and distinct room responses. Input reference uses the earlier inverted bandlimited 0.25 gain and Gaussian noise (sigma 24 PCM16). In the intervention fade over 160 samples from actual OPEN, then keep player silent and retain room decay. Microphone and ADC reference prefixes must be identical. No open means no intervention.
